title: Complete private voting
summary: Integrate identity, register, sealed vote, uniqueness, and final verification so a citizen can exercise voting rights without losing privacy.
dramaticDescription: Now everything converges: protected identity, verifiable register, sealed vote, and guaranteed uniqueness. You have built a system where a citizen can exercise their right without being observed.
introScene: The agent awaits you in the final hall of the system. Everything you built in previous missions now integrates: the witness, the Merkle tree, the commitment, and the nullifier work together to make private, verifiable voting possible.
